text: __NOTOC__ Tiny Titanium Lockbox is a rare type of lockbox that requires 400 lockpicking to open.
Timely Death is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Loken in the Halls of Lightning on Heroic difficulty in 2 minutes or less.
Tingiyok is a tuskarr drink vendor located at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising, and his stall was defended by Asric and Jadaar.

Tirisfal Glades is a level 1-10 Horde-only zone in Lordaeron, and begins the Undead starting experience. After Take to the Skies, or as soon as players hit level 9, Warchief's Command: Silverpine Forest! opens up, starting the Silverpine Forest storyline.
Tinza Silvermug is a goblin innkeeper located in the Orgrimmar Embassy of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Tiny Oasis Mosaic is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Tol'vir Archaeology Fragments to complete. Up to two keystones may be used to solve this artifact.
Tiny Bronze Scorpion is a common archaeology artifact that requires 45 Orc Archaeology Fragments to complete and allows the use of two keystones.
__NOTOC__ The Tiny Shale Spider is a shale spider companion.
Tiny Treasure Chest has a chance to drop from any mob in Cataclysm zones and instances while under the effect of Potion of Treasure Finding.
Timeway Headgear can be found inside Murozond's Temporal Cache after defeating Murozond in End Time.
Tireless Pursuit was a talent planned to be introduced with Mists of Pandaria.
Tiriosh, Nightmare of Ages is a quest reward from Patricide, the final part of a legendary questline available to rogues.

Tini Smalls is a goblin vendor found in Area 52 in the Netherstorm. She sells vintage Horde PvP cloth and leather armor. In order to purchase from her you must have the appropriate Legacy achievement from the old PvP ranking system (eg: Legionnaire (Legacy); Knight-Captain (Legacy)).
Ting Ting is a mushan located in the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Tired Shushen is a jinyu waterspeaker located in Fallsong Village in Krasarang Wilds.

Timing is Everything is an achievement that is awarded for defeating two Kor'thik Reavers within 10 seconds of each other and and then defeat Grand Empress Shek'zeer in the Heart of Fear raid instance.
__NOTOC__ The Tiny Fel Engine Key drops from Void Reaver in The Eye.
Tiny Tayger is a goblin who sells Legacy Arena Weapons at Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He assisted in its defense during the Legion invasions.
Timothy Leens is the foreman of the Lunarfall Excavation for the Alliance garrison. He can refine Draenic Stone into ore.
Ting is a pig located at the Thunderfoot Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds. This pig is found together with Jian and Ning under a building.

Tiny is an elekk located at the Shattrath Port Authority in Talador. It rescued Aellaana from Iron Horde orcs but became wounded. Field Medic Nesrerah is healing him.

Timeworn Artifacts are a currency found at the Timeworn Strand in Azsuna. They can be looted from mobs, Timeworn Jars, and players in the area while Operation Murloc Freedom is active; they cannot be obtained at any other time. They're turned in to King Mrgl-Mrgl at the Timeworn Strand in exchange for Honor, at a rate of 1 Honor for every 4 Artifacts.
__NOTOC__ Timeworn Strand is a shoreline with ancient night elven ruins found in north-western Azsuna. The Shoalfin murlocs here are being enslaved by the naga.

Tiptog the Lost is an ettin located in the Valley of the Sword in Stormheim.

Tirna Vaal is a dream tree and grove located in eastern Ardenweald. It is the grove of Droman Tashmur and has taken in refugees from Heartwood Grove. Guardian Kota is leader of the Wild Hunt stationed here.
Tirna Eas is located in northern Ardenweald. It is the grove of the Lady of the Falls.
Tirna Fenn is a dream tree located in northwestern Ardenweald. It is the grove of Droman Dawnblossom, and is entirely populated by faeries. It is the mostly densely forested area of Ardenweald.
Tirna Glayn is a dream tree located in eastern Ardenweald. It is the grove of Droman Aliothe.
Tirna Kaithe is a dream tree located in southern Ardenweald. It keeps the Gormhive in check with the Wild Hunt.
Tirna Marwol is a dream tree located in southwestern Ardenweald that fell long ago. It is being overtaken by the Drust and no longer has a heart.
Tirna Rowen, also called the Fallen Tree, is a dream tree located in northeastern Ardenweald. Its groves were culled just as the adventurer was arriving.

Tirna Scithe is located in western Ardenweald. It is the grove of Droman Oulfarran, and the home of the Tirnenn. Marasmius has a root network station near the tree. The area around the tree has been infested with gorm.

Tito is the wolf pet summoned by Dorothee, a boss in the Opera House in Karazhan. The show had to be stopped on more than one occasion when Tito and Roar would lock eyes, resulting in an extended chase around the Karazhan Opera House. He can be seen in the backstage during the Return to Karazhan.

For player characters, titles are displayed before or after the character's name, usually as an indication of the character's achievements. While a character may have earned multiple titles, only one can be displayed at a time — players can choose which title to display, if any, in the Titles tab of the character info frame. For mobs and NPCs, titles appear after the name (surrounded by <>s). They usually help identify either the faction or organization the creature belongs to or what kind of service they might provide.
